name: kilnshell
description: Fast, telemetry-free local MCP: shell, files, search, processes, PDF, Excel and Word for agents.
long_description: Kilnshell gives an AI agent your terminal and your files: run commands and long-lived processes, read, write and surgically edit files, search code and contents with ripgrep, and work with PDF, Excel and Word documents. A performance-focused, telemetry-free clone of Desktop Commander: commands start up to 100x faster because the login shell environment is resolved once, and nothing is ever sent anywhere.
